Morning team — quick, time-boxed ask to get the Friday submission tidy. Please read and action before the 10:00 PT sync.

- Set the commit flag only if legal and procurement milestones are green or there is an explicit contract signature timeline within 7 days.
- Add top-3 risks on deals > $250k in the “Risks” column (reason, owner, mitigation).
- Run the deal-cleanse checklist for any opportunities older than 30 days.

Agenda for 10:00–10:15 PT (15 minutes):
1) Quick lane snapshot (Marissa) — 3 minutes
2) High-dollar exceptions & ask for escalations — 7 minutes
3) Final submission confirmation & submit owner (Neha) — 5 minutes

Submit here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cForecastFolder (I updated the Q2 template).
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

Thanks — see you at 10.
